messages.subject: Gulf Energy Environment | International ESG, Sustainability & Regulatory Executive | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Gulf Energy Environment HR Team,

Your environmental and energy focus in Saudi Arabia closely matches my background in ESG, regulatory engagement and responsible industrial development. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications. I also support governance around industrial renewable-energy and carbon-data initiatives.

I am seeking Director, Senior Director or Head-level roles across ESG, sustainability, environmental stakeholder strategy, government relations, external affairs and responsible business. I bring extensive experience connecting public institutions and operating teams in a complex natural-resource environment.

I am internationally mobile, available following a 30-day notice period and require employer-supported work authorization. My attached three-page executive CV is submitted for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth “Randy” Ramsaroop
